attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (async standbys), with all replication traffic carried over TLS using a dedicated cluster CA generated on node1. The primary's pg_hba.conf restricts replication to hostssl connections presenting a certificate issued by that CA (cert auth method with clientcert=verify-full), scoped to node2/node3 IPs and the replicator role only. Verified rejection of connections without a client cert and with a non-CA-issued (self-signed) cert. All three nodes were restarted sequentially (both replicas first, primary last) via systemctl reboot; boot IDs changed on each node and post-restart replication/TLS health was confirmed via new writes replicating to both standbys.
